negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak-language trade outlet or newsletter covering the payments-processing/acquiring industry as an industry (people moves, hub news) was found; SK payments coverage is scattered across general finance media (Finsider, Trend, HN) and PR wires.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for SK payments-sector trade press returned only consumer-facing card/bank stories and job boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no single high-yield SK feed for A5-type events; collection must be assembled from registers plus employer sites plus general media, raising cost and latency.

negative_findings.description: No SK-specific corporate presence or Slovak legal entity for NCR Atleos surfaced in search; only the US-listed parent appeared. Its SK footprint (if any) may sit under a Czech or Hungarian entity, or under an outsourced service partner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query pairing Diebold Nixdorf with NCR Atleos in Bratislava returned Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. records only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One named actor in the cell may have no direct SK employer footprint; ATM-estate signals for NCR may have to be tracked via bank tenders and service partners instead.

negative_findings.description: No Visa or Mastercard country-manager-for-Slovakia appointment announcement was found in either sk or en searching; scheme coverage appears to be run from a Prague/CEE cluster with SK folded into CZ&SK roles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak query 'Visa Mastercard country manager Slovensko vymenovanie' returned card-portfolio news and a Prague-based CZ&SK Mastercard vacancy, no appointment news.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's assumption of discrete SK country managers at the schemes may be partly wrong; monitoring should target CZ/CEE cluster announcements and Workday postings rather than SK-only news.

negative_findings.description: No Wirecard-successor entity with a live Slovak operation was identified in this pass; no SK-language term for such successors surfaced beyond generic 'platobná inštitúcia'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not evidenced in searches performed; the actor was not pursued to exhaustion.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named actor group in the cell brief may be irrelevant to SK, or requires a different entity-name entry point (e.g. via NBS PSD2 register diffing rather than by brand name).

negative_findings.description: It is unconfirmed whether ÚPSVaR proactively publishes a list of received mass-layoff notifications, or whether such lists are obtainable only by FOI request.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ÚPSVaR page describes employer obligations but no public notification register was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-value layoff early-warning channel may be FOI-gated, which changes collection design (periodic infožiadosť rather than scraping).

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn — the richest source for country-manager and hub-lead moves — is auth-walled and its ToS prohibits automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages surfaced in search but content is login-gated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A core A5 signal channel cannot be automated; budget for manual analyst review or a licensed people-data provider.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate NBS supervised-entity and PSD2 register categories for ATM/cash-services operators and build an IČO watchlist; cross-check with Obchodný vestník.

coverage_gaps.description: Košice and other regional SK delivery/shared-service locations of payments firms were not investigated; searching concentrated on Bratislava.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sk-language searches on 'Košice centrum zdieľaných služieb platby / IT centrum' plus regional media (korzar.sme.sk, kosice.dnes24.sk) and regional ÚPSVaR offices.

coverage_gaps.description: SK general business media (Trend/eTrend, Hospodárske noviny, Forbes.sk, Index SME, Touchit) were not individually assessed as monitored feeds for payments people-moves.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess each for RSS availability, paywall depth and a 'ľudia a kariéry' / appointments column; add the viable ones as keyword-filtered feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme-side (Visa/Mastercard) CEE regional newsrooms and their CZ-language equivalents were not located; SK announcements likely originate there.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Identify Visa/Mastercard CEE press pages and CZ newsrooms and monitor them as the upstream channel for SK-relevant appointments.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live; all liveness/status assessments are hypotheses from search-result metadata.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: The SK glossary built here is thin on employment-event verbs used in appointment reporting (e.g. 'vymenovaný do funkcie', 'novým riaditeľom sa stal', 'posilnil vedenie', 'ukončil pôsobenie', 'presúva pracovné miesta').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the sk query set with these verb phrases combined with actor names, and add CZ-language variants given CZ/SK cluster reporting.

brief: Slovakia's payments-employer intelligence is register-first rather than newsroom-first: the highest-value, freely collectable signals for country-manager and org changes sit in NBS's supervised-entity and PSD2 registers, ORSR statutory-officer extracts, Obchodný vestník transformation notices, and registeruz.sk headcount filings, with FinStat as a convenient aggregator. Hiring and hub-trajectory signals come from Profesia company pages, the state sluzbyzamestnanosti portal, and employer ATS pages (Euronet/Trakstar, Diebold Nixdorf SK openings, Mastercard Workday CZ&SK postings), while the statutory hromadné prepúšťanie notification to ÚPSVaR is the key layoff early-warning channel — though it may be FOI-gated rather than published. Local media coverage is thin and generalist (Finsider, TASR OTS, SITA); there is no dedicated SK payments trade outlet, so appointments surface first on LinkedIn, which is auth-walled and ToS-restricted and must be handled manually or via a licensed provider. Notably, Visa/Mastercard appear to run Slovakia inside a Prague/CEE cluster rather than through discrete SK country managers, so scheme monitoring should point at CZ/CEE channels, and no SK footprint was evidenced for NCR Atleos or Wirecard successors.
